Puneeth BA 
Full Stack Developer (Angular | Java | Spring Boot | Flutter) 
puneethba2000@gmail.com | +91 7022287803| linkedin.com/in/puneeth-ba-61b555220 | Bangalore, Karnataka 
Professional Summary 
Full Stack Developer with 3 years of hands-on experience in designing and developing enterprise applications 
using Angular (13+) for dynamic, responsive frontends and Java Spring Boot for scalable, high-performance 
backends. Strong expertise in Core Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate, and Dependency 
Injection, with proven ability to build secure, efficient REST APIs and integrate with relational databases. Skilled 
in developing modular Angular components, RxJS-based state management, reactive forms, routing, and lazy 
loading for seamless user experiences. Adept at working in Agile/Scrum teams, delivering clean, maintainable 
code, and mentoring junior developers. 
Recognized for quickly adapting to new technologies, optimizing application performance, and delivering high-
quality solutions that align with business goals.

• Angular 13+, TypeScript, RxJS, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, SCSS

• State Management (RxJS), Custom Directives & Pipes, Component Communication 
• UI Frameworks: Angular Material, Bootstrap 
• PWA (Progressive Web Apps), Responsive Web Design 
Backend (Java & Spring): 
• Core Java (OOPs, Collections, Streams, Exception Handling) 
• Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate ORM 
• Spring Security (JWT, OAuth2, Role-based Access Control) 
• Dependency Injection (DI), RESTful API Development 
• Database Integration: MySQL, MongoDB 
Tools & Platforms:

• Flutter (Android & iOS) – cross-platform mobile app development, state management, and deployment 
to Play Store & App Store

• Conducted code reviews, enforced clean coding practices, and mentored junior developers.
